decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The changelog line [ev-207e01544690] only names the command, but the linked PR [ev-24245e59f535] spells it out. It says `flux migrate` moves Flux custom resources stored in Kubernetes etcd to their latest API version. It must be run before a Flux minor upgrade, and it is a prerequisite for upgrading to 2.7, where v1beta1 and v2beta1 are being removed from the Flux CRDs. [ev-9e5f259b62f3] lists the affected groups: source, kustomize, notification and image `.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta1`, plus helm `.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2beta1`. It also says Flux Operator users don't need to run the command. That is enough to write the applicability: clusters whose stored Flux objects are still in those deprecated API versions and that are not managed by Flux Operator. It also shows the proposals' "informational / no consequence" reading is wrong, because they cited only the changelog line.
